title: One Kilowatt, Eleven Winters
subtitle: 能源利用 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 能源利用（环境保护·能源与可再生）
meta: 主题语境：能源利用（环境保护·能源与可再生）　|　核心词汇：unit　|　正文 399 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 unit 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My father did not care about the environment. He cared about the ① unit on the bill, which is one kilowatt-hour, and about how many of them a house could be persuaded to give up. He was a meter reader for twenty-six years and the only ② unit of measurement he trusted was the one he could hear: the meter's click, faster in a cold kitchen, slower in a warm one.

Our own house was the experiment. He replaced the bulbs, then the tank, then the ③ unit under the stairs that heated the water nobody used. Each ④ unit he installed came with a calculation on the back of an envelope and, usually, an argument with my mother about the cost. Every unit, he said, tells a story about the house it sits in. He was not wrong about the arithmetic and he was often wrong about the house.

In 2009 the council fitted solar panels on eleven roofs, including ours. The ⑤ unit on the wall that showed what we generated became the most watched object in the kitchen. My mother, who had lost every previous argument, watched it for a fortnight and then said the ⑥ unit of account was wrong: the panels were paying us in money, and she wanted to be paid in warmth. She had a point, and he knew it, and he did not say so.

The scheme was run by a small ⑦ unit inside the council — four people, one van — which is the sense of the word I had not known. They were, as a ⑧ unit, more effective than the department that replaced them, which had forty-one staff and eleven forms, and a unit is only ever as honest as the person reading it. Smallness, I have noticed since, is not the same as weakness, and the ⑨ unit in which my mother kept her accounts was warmth, not pounds, which is sometimes useful to remember.

My father died in 2018 and the meter was read by radio after that, and then not read at all. The click, which had been the only honest ⑩ unit in that house for twenty-six years, was replaced by an estimate, and the estimate was always generous, and nobody complained. I still watch the box on the wall. It says what the sun did, which is not what we used, and the gap between those two numbers is the whole subject.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. （成套的）设备；装置；机组
C. n. （组织中的）部门；小队；单位
D. n. 单位（计数、货币的）单位
E. 固定搭配：unit of measurement 计量单位
F. 固定搭配：unit of account 记账单位
G. n. （整体的）一个成员；个体（as a unit）

items.q: the only unit of measurement he trusted
the unit under the stairs that heated the water
The unit on the wall that showed what we generated
the unit of account was wrong
The scheme was run by a small unit inside the council
They were, as a unit, more effective
the unit in which my mother kept her accounts was warmth
the only honest unit in that house

answers.why: 指账单上的计费“单位”，即一千瓦时。
unit of measurement 意为“计量单位”，此处说他只信能听见的那一声咔哒。
指楼梯下那台烧水的“装置、设备”，即热水器机组。
指他装上的每一个“部件、组件”，每一个都附一张信封背面的算式。
指墙上显示发电量的那台“装置”，即电表／显示器。
unit of account 意为“记账单位”，母亲认为不该用钱而应用暖和程度来算。
指议会内部一个“小部门、小组”——四个人、一辆车。
as a unit 意为“作为一个整体”，说这四个人整体比接管他们的部门更有效。
指计量的“单位、口径”，母亲认为家里的账不该用英镑而该用暖和程度来记。
指这一家里唯一诚实的“计量单位”，即那声咔哒。
